title: Best stretch with updates
statement:
You are given an array a[1..n] of integers and q operations, each one of:
U i v: set a[i] to v.
Q l r: print the largest sum of a contiguous non-empty subarray lying inside a[l..r].

Input: the first line holds n and q. The second line holds a[1..n]. Each of the next q lines holds one operation.

Output: for every Q operation, one line with the answer, in order.

Constraints: 1 <= n, q <= 20000, 1 <= i <= n, 1 <= l <= r <= n, -10^4 <= a[i], v <= 10^4. Answering each query in O(r - l) time is too slow for the largest tests; aim for O(log n) per operation.

Example:
Input:
5 4
2 -3 4 -1 2
Q 1 5
Q 1 2
U 2 5
Q 1 3
Output:
5
2
11
(Q 1 5: 4 -1 2 gives 5. Q 1 2: the best is 2 alone. After a[2] = 5, Q 1 3: 2 5 4 gives 11.)
starter_code:
